dq.t: Rows marked 'No Office' (not real units) were excluded from unit counts
Units with no Unit Status (neither Rented nor Vacant) - shown as 'status not recorded'
Rented units with no lease End Date - cannot be placed in renewals
Rented units with no Rent amount
Rented units with no Tenant Name
Rented units whose lease End Date is already before the data date - renewal overdue or master not updated
Duplicate property + unit number rows in the Master Sheet
Legal column blank (and 'No' written as both 'No' and 'NO')
Payment line items in the workbook
Payment rows with no usable cheque Date (blank or text such as 'DNR') - excluded from monthly figures
Rows with Date = 'DNR' (text in the date column)
Payment rows with blank Status
Payment rows with no Amount
Payment rows with no Bank
Cheque dated beyond 2027 (likely a typo, e.g. 2029)
Cheque dated before June 2025 (outside the period the data covers)

Property names that appear in Payments but not in the Master Sheet: Al Ghleila, Al Mahatta, Al Rashidiya Villa, Al Wahi 1 (Abu Dhabi, Al Ghadeer), Baridi, Jafiliyya, Masfout, Mirqab, Musalla, Nasra Ahmad, RAK 1, RAK 2, Serena Casa Dora, Sulafa Tower, Unidentified
Payment rows belonging to properties with no unit list in the Master Sheet
Rows that look duplicated (same property, unit, date, cheque no. and amount)
Properties whose rent cheques name more than one beneficiary (spelling or ownership)
Rows with Description 'No info available' - treated as Other income
Expense line items in the workbook
Expense rows with no Amount (e.g. maintenance entries awaiting an invoice)
Expense rows with no Paid date - shown as 'pending / not yet paid', not in any month
Expense rows with more than one Paid date in one cell - the latest date is used
Expense rows whose Paid cell has text but no readable date
Expense rows recorded against an owner or group of buildings, not one property - shown as 'portfolio-level'
Portfolios that have owner-level expense or distribution rows (distributions are recorded per owner, never per property)
Expense row with no Property - placed under Al Zarouni portfolio-level because the description names the Zarouni Portfolio
Duplicate expense Ref No values
